text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, losartan potassium 25 mg tablets are not on the FDA drug shortage list. Corvale East holds 113 tablets (10.6 days on hand at 10.6 tablets per day). Corvale General holds 361 tablets (26.3 days on hand at 13.7 tablets per day).

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include losartan potassium as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory at Corvale East is low and requires prompt replenishment. Corvale General has adequate supply for the near term. Alternate manufacturers are available and not on the FDA shortage list.

Recommended actions:
1. Verify current inventory at both sites against the days-on-hand figures. (Buyer approves)
2. Place orders with Macleods Pharmaceuticals Limited (plant last inspected VAI 2023-10-20) to replenish Corvale East stock. (Buyer approves)
3. Place orders with Strides Pharma Science Limited (plant Strides Alathur Private Limited last inspected VAI 2024-04-05) as a secondary source. (Buyer approves)
4. Monitor inventory weekly and adjust orders to maintain at least 14 days on hand at both sites. (Buyer approves)

Not recommended: Do not order from AiPing Pharmaceutical, Inc., Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc., or Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited at this time because their labels do not name identifiable plants for quality verification.
